# Linear algebra slides

```{python}
#| output: asis
import glob

import yaml

files = sorted(glob.glob("lec*.qmd"))

for file in files:
    html = file.replace("qmd", "html")

    with open(file) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
        end_yml_line_number = lines[1:].index("---\n")
        yaml_block = "\n".join(
            lines[1:end_yml_line_number]
        )
        metadata = yaml.load(
            yaml_block, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader
        )
        subtitle = metadata["subtitle"]

    title = f"`{html}`: {subtitle}"
    print(f"- [{title}]({html})")
```
